---
title: "Stock assessments"
---

How many of the stocks ICES gives advice on have their assessment in TAF, and how far along it is.

Each stock is placed by the [TAF readiness level](../system/readiness-level.qmd) of its assessment repository in [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) for the year. A stock is published when it also has a repository for the year in [ices-advice](https://github.com/ices-advice). The stocks, their expert group and data category come from the [ICES Stock Database](https://sd.ices.dk). The individual assessments are listed under [TAF readiness](readiness.qmd).

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_plot.R")

stocks <- read.csv("../_generated/stocks.csv")
stocks$category <- factor(stocks$category, c("Category 1", "Categories 2-6"))

# from the most to the least advanced, the order the bars are stacked in
states <- c("Level 2", "Level 1", "No level", "No repository")
state_colours <- setNames(c("#3987e5", "#9ec5f4", "#c9c8c1", "#efeeea"), states)
stocks$state <- factor(
  ifelse(is.na(stocks$level), "No repository", ifelse(stocks$level == 0, "No level", paste("Level", stocks$level))),
  states
)
# in TAF to some degree: there is code, so level 1 or above
stocks$in_taf <- stocks$level %in% 1:4

# the headline figures: the last three years, the latest still under way if
# it is the current year
this_year <- as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
recent <- tail(sort(unique(stocks$year)), 3)
complete <- max(recent[recent < this_year])
year_label <- ifelse(recent == this_year, paste(recent, "so far"), recent)

count <- function(of, among = TRUE) sapply(recent, function(y) sum(of & among & stocks$year == y))
with_percent <- function(n, total) sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * n / total)
cat1 <- stocks$category == "Category 1"
n_groups <- function(among) sapply(recent, function(y) length(unique(stocks$eg[stocks$year == y & among])))

headline <- rbind(
  "Stocks with TAF code published with the advice" = with_percent(count(stocks$published), count(TRUE)),
  "of which category 1 stocks" = with_percent(count(stocks$published, cat1), count(cat1)),
  "Stocks with assessment code in TAF" = with_percent(count(stocks$in_taf), count(TRUE)),
  "of which passing the QC test" = count(stocks$level %in% 2),
  "Expert groups with assessment code in TAF" = paste(n_groups(stocks$in_taf), "of", n_groups(TRUE))
)
colnames(headline) <- year_label

last <- stocks[stocks$year == complete, ]
current <- unique(stocks$stock[stocks$year == max(stocks$year)])
```

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Current status

In `r complete`, the last complete year, **`r sum(last$published)` stocks had TAF code published with their advice**: `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(last$published))` of all stocks and `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(last$published[last$category == "Category 1"]))` of the category 1 stocks. **`r sum(current %in% stocks$stock[stocks$in_taf])` of the `r length(current)` current stocks** have had assessment code in TAF in at least one year since `r min(stocks$year)`.

```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(headline, align = "r")
```

Percentages are of the stocks ICES gives advice on in the year.
:::

## Stocks by readiness level

One panel for the category 1 stocks and one for the stocks in categories 2 to 6. The height of a bar is the number of stocks, and the line shows how many of them are published. The menu above the chart switches between the number of stocks and the percentage of the stocks in the category.

```{r}
#| echo: false
counts <- as.data.frame(table(year = stocks$year, category = stocks$category, state = stocks$state))
names(counts)[4] <- "n"
published <- aggregate(cbind(n = published) ~ year + category, stocks, sum)
published$state <- "Published"

# everything drawn: the bars for each state and the line for the published
drawn <- rbind(counts, published[names(counts)])
drawn$year <- as.numeric(as.character(drawn$year))
total <- table(stocks$year, stocks$category)
drawn$percent <- 100 * drawn$n / total[cbind(as.character(drawn$year), as.character(drawn$category))]
# nothing was published before the first year with a published stock
first_published <- min(c(published$year[published$n > 0], Inf))
drawn <- drawn[drawn$state != "Published" | drawn$year >= first_published, ]

# one panel of the chart: the stocks of a category by year and state
panel <- function(category, legend) {
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (state in states) {
    p <- p |>
      add_bars(
        data = drawn[drawn$category == category & drawn$state == state, ],
        x = ~year, y = ~n, name = state,
        legendgroup = state, showlegend = legend,
        marker = list(color = state_colours[[state]], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
        hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y} stocks"
      )
  }
  p |>
    add_trace(
      data = drawn[drawn$category == category & drawn$state == "Published", ],
      x = ~year, y = ~n, name = "Published",
      legendgroup = "Published", showlegend = legend,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = orange, width = 2),
      marker = list(color = orange, size = 8, line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
      hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y} stocks"
    ) |>
    layout(
      barmode = "stack",
      xaxis = list(title = "", dtick = 1),
      yaxis = list(title = "Stocks")
    )
}

# the menu: the values of every bar and line as a number or a percentage, in
# the order they are drawn
menu_entry <- function(label, column, hover, suffix) {
  values <- list()
  for (category in levels(stocks$category)) {
    for (state in c(states, "Published")) {
      values <- c(values, list(drawn[[column]][drawn$category == category & drawn$state == state]))
    }
  }
  list(
    method = "update", label = label,
    args = list(
      list(y = values, hovertemplate = hover),
      list(yaxis.title.text = label, yaxis.ticksuffix = suffix)
    )
  )
}
menu <- list(
  x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.04, yanchor = "bottom",
  buttons = list(
    menu_entry("Stocks", "n", "%{x}: %{y} stocks", ""),
    menu_entry("Percentage of stocks", "percent", "%{x}: %{y:.0f}% of stocks", "%")
  )
)

panels <- lapply(levels(stocks$category), function(category) panel(category, category == "Category 1"))
subplot(panels, shareY = TRUE, margin = 0.03) |>
  taf_layout(
    annotations = list(
      list(text = "<b>Category 1</b>", x = 0, xref = "x domain", y = 1.04, yref = "paper", xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE),
      list(text = "<b>Categories 2-6</b>", x = 0, xref = "x2 domain", y = 1.04, yref = "paper", xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE)
    ),
    updatemenus = list(menu),
    margin = list(t = 60)
  ) |>
  layout(legend = list(y = -0.12, traceorder = "normal"))
```

## Coverage by expert group

The percentage of each expert group's stocks that have assessment code in TAF, at level 1 or above. Click a group in the legend to hide it, and double-click to show it on its own.

```{r}
#| echo: false
groups <- aggregate(cbind(in_taf, level2 = level %in% 2, published, stocks = 1) ~ eg + year, stocks, sum)
groups$coverage <- 100 * groups$in_taf / groups$stocks

# the league table: the groups in the latest year, most covered first
league <- groups[groups$year == max(groups$year), ]
league <- league[order(-league$coverage, -league$in_taf, league$eg), ]

# eight colours, then the same again with dashed and dotted lines
palette <- c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300", "#6250d6", "#e34948")
dashes <- c("solid", "dash", "dot")

p <- plot_ly()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(league))) {
  d <- groups[groups$eg == league$eg[i], ]
  colour <- palette[(i - 1) %% length(palette) + 1]
  p <- p |>
    add_trace(
      data = d, x = ~year, y = ~coverage, name = league$eg[i],
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = colour, width = 2, dash = dashes[(i - 1) %/% length(palette) + 1]),
      marker = list(color = colour, size = 6),
      customdata = ~paste(in_taf, "of", stocks),
      hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y:.0f}% (%{customdata} stocks)"
    )
}
p |>
  taf_layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "", dtick = 1),
    yaxis = list(title = "Stocks with code in TAF", ticksuffix = "%", range = c(-3, 103))
  ) |>
  layout(legend = list(orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1))
```

The groups in `r max(stocks$year)`, ordered by coverage.

```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    "Expert group" = league$eg,
    "Stocks" = league$stocks,
    "With code in TAF" = league$in_taf,
    "Coverage" = sprintf("%.0f%%", league$coverage),
    "Level 2" = league$level2,
    "Published" = league$published,
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrrrr"
)
```
